question: Why did more than 20 countries, most of them African, walk out of the 1976 Olympics over a rugby tour?
answer: Because New Zealand's rugby team had toured apartheid South Africa, and they wanted New Zealand thrown out of the Games. The IOC refused: rugby was not an Olympic sport and it had no say over the tour. Athletes who had trained for years flew home around the opening ceremony without competing.
move: Pressure lands on whoever can be reached, not on whoever can act.
ask: When I push for change, am I pressing the person who can actually make it?
reference: Christopher R. Hill, Olympic Politics, 2nd edition, Manchester University Press, 1996
